fusions.name: Doubled Braid
fusions.desc: Throws a strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then plaits on to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Pull Tight
fusions.desc: Deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Tangle Field
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Fringe
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, a strand snags the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
